title: Zion Windows
paragraphs: I had been to Zion before, and this time I spent my two days on the east side of the park. There the Zion-Mount Carmel Highway climbs out of the canyon in a series of switchbacks, past red stone parapets and a little arched bridge, then disappears straight into the mountain. In early May the trees were a fresh spring green against the red rock, and every pullout offered another cream, pink and vermilion tower against a bright blue sky. Then came the tunnel. Finished in 1930, it has windows cut right through the canyon wall, and each one frames the cliffs like a painting in a gallery. Who puts windows in a tunnel? I'm glad someone did. Stopping inside is not allowed, so you take what you can from the car as the arches roll past.

Past the tunnel, the canyon walls give way to smooth, striped slickrock that rolls off in every direction, with ponderosa and pinyon pines rooted wherever a crack holds a little soil. I know those stripes by now: sand dunes turned to Navajo Sandstone. I still have trouble believing that I walked across a desert no person ever saw. Up at the viewpoints, narrow gorges cut deep between overhanging ledges, and across the way a giant alcove had been scooped out of a cliff, the Great Arch of Zion, I believe. Even the small things stood out. Down by my feet, a single white daisy was growing out of dry, rocky ground.

By evening the low sun had turned the slickrock gold and filled the gorges with shadow. Camp that night was a tent hung between the trees and a campfire in a pit of orange sand. The next day the tunnel offered its windows again, and the same cliffs looked different through every one.

photos.caption: Mount Carmel Highway
photos.alt: A road with a double yellow line runs past roadside boulders and green shrubs beneath a red and white sandstone mountain.

photos.caption: Stone Bridge
photos.alt: A curving road along a hillside leads to a stone-walled bridge, with a dark red peak and bright sun above.

photos.caption: Cream and Vermilion
photos.alt: Distant cream and white-capped sandstone towers above a green valley, with a huge red cliff rising on the right.

photos.caption: Spring Green
photos.alt: Bright green leaves in the foreground, with a sunlit red sandstone peak capped in white rising behind.

photos.caption: Gallery
photos.alt: Inside the tunnel, a stone-walled sill beneath an arched window that opens onto sunlit red cliffs.

photos.caption: Postcard
photos.alt: A rounded tunnel window framing a lone pine and a row of red and cream sandstone cliffs against a blue sky.

photos.caption: Cathedral Window
photos.alt: An arched tunnel window framing a tall red sandstone peak with a pale cap, above a stone sill and a concrete road edge.

photos.caption: Capstone
photos.alt: A flat-topped peak with a red cap rock above a slope of pine and juniper under a clear blue sky.

photos.caption: Slickrock Country
photos.alt: Panorama of pale and rust-colored slickrock hills dotted with pine trees under scattered clouds.

photos.caption: Great Arch
photos.alt: A huge arch-shaped alcove scooped out of a striped sandstone cliff, with small pines clinging to the slope.

photos.caption: Small Wonder
photos.alt: A single white daisy with a yellow center growing from dry rocky soil beside a weathered piece of wood.

photos.caption: Tight Squeeze
photos.alt: A narrow sandstone gorge with overhanging ledges, swirled rock slabs and a few small pines under a blue sky.

photos.caption: Sun Catcher
photos.alt: Looking up at a twisted pine backlit by the sun, beside red sandstone ledges.

photos.caption: Frozen Dunes
photos.alt: A smooth, swirled sandstone slab beneath an overhanging cliff, with a distant ridge across the gorge.

photos.caption: Beehive
photos.alt: A rounded dome of layered orange sandstone with a few small pines on top, in a gorge below tall cliff walls.

photos.caption: Snag
photos.alt: Panorama of a rugged ridge of red and white sandstone, with a gnarled dead tree standing in the foreground.

photos.caption: Freckled
photos.alt: A pale sandstone pinnacle dotted with shrubs rising above red slickrock, with pines and desert brush in the foreground.

photos.caption: Sand Steps
photos.alt: Layered sandstone ledges with drifts of pale sand, a tall pine trunk and a pine-covered cliff behind.

photos.caption: Golden Hour
photos.alt: Late golden light on a deep gorge of layered slickrock, framed by a bare gnarled tree at the left.

photos.caption: Treehouse
photos.alt: A tent suspended between trees with orange straps, above a pale rock slab and green shrubs.

photos.caption: Hearth
photos.alt: A campfire burning in a shallow pit on pale sandy rock at dusk, with dry branches nearby and a tent hanging in the trees behind.

photos.caption: Lean-To
photos.alt: A bare pine limb with tufts of green needles lies across a pale green and yellow camp shelter in a flashlight beam at night.

photos.caption: Campfire
photos.alt: Bright flames rising from a campfire in a shallow pit of orange sand at night.

photos.caption: Parting Shot
photos.alt: A tunnel window framing a red sandstone cliff with vertical grooves and a pale-capped peak against a deep blue sky.
